example_sentences_in_bangla: এই সম্পত্তির অংশ তার হকের ধন।
কাজের বিনিময়ে মজুরি তার হকের ধন।
example_sentences_in_english: This portion of the property is his rightful due.
The wages in exchange for work are his just claim.
note: The term 'হক' derives from Arabic 'haq' meaning truth or right, commonly used in Bengali for rightful claims.
